Episode 246. The Battle for Mithra Desert (10)
Now, the key to liberating Lafrarosa is not technology but time.

Of course, securing time was not easy. The desert was always filled with the Chemyung Tribe and Demon Tribe, so a way had to be devised to operate the device stably for a long time without their interference.
But compared to before, when no clues could be found, now hope seemed within reach.
"Yona, you go and tell the commander the situation. We will retreat immediately."
"Ye-Yes, Sir Owl."
"Be careful, Yona."
"Thank you, Luna sis!"
With the addition of an aerial fortress and the Demon Tribe's full engagement, the battle was noticeably intensifying with every second.
But it was not too difficult for Yona to move. Wielding death, she swept away the enemy's brainwaves and advanced across the desert.
She intended to retrace the path Luna had taken. Despite the enemy's brainwave interference, sandstorms, and intermittent flashes blinding her sight, Yona accurately discerned the path Luna had used.
'Heh, was sis in a hurry too? Or does she have a surprisingly clumsy side?'
Chemyung Tribe Reconnaissance Team.

While searching for the second team, Luna failed to notice that they were following her. Their special camouflage uniforms had the effect of becoming highly transparent upon contact with enemy brainwaves.
Thud!
Death pierced the ground. A Chemyung member's heart was penetrated along with the sand, hidden within the enemy's brainwave.
"It seems sis was too busy to notice you. I will kill all of you on my way, so if you want to live, start running away now, heh."

At first, the Chemyung reconnaissance team thought their deceased comrade's concealment was insufficient. But from that moment, Yona relentlessly raced across the desert, tirelessly seeking and killing the team.
"Heh, fools. If you weren't followers of my sister, I would have tortured you more before killing you."
Thus, Yona killed a total of thirty-two reconnaissance team members by the time she rejoined Jin's party.
"Jin's brother... This person is..."
Linfa was the first to discover Yona. Upon seeing Linfa recognize her immediately, Yona was again freshly surprised, just like with Eltiot.
"Wow, the Sovereign Tribe must all have great instincts."
"Yona Runkandel! Right? I heard a lot about you from Jin's brother."

Belliz, who was just knocked to the ground by the enemy's brainwave cannon, looked at Yona and smiled. Although she had fallen hard enough to create a crater in the ground, there was not a single bruise on Belliz's body.
"Heh, I'm glad to see you too. You're incredibly tough!"
"Have you arrived, Sister? What happened to the second team?"
"We can retreat now, Kwaoul. Creating the device to liberate Lafrarosa is not difficult now, all we need to do is figure out how to buy time to use it."
Jin's eyes widened. The day when all his brothers would come back was really not far off.
"Understood. Sister, please retreat with me."
"Jin's brother! Linfa's brother and I will shuttle between the second team and this side to provide cover. How far do we need to retreat?"
"We need to get to the southern edge of the desert. From there, we can also use the space jump equipment."

Thanks to the commotion caused by the trio of demons, the retreat was not expected to be very difficult. The Chemyung Tribe's aerial fortresses and fleets were constantly circling overhead to avoid Masalrun's curse.
So, despite their overwhelming mobility, it wasn't easy to pursue Jin and his party. Masalrun was now fighting entirely 'on Jin's side.'
"Those demons are a great help. We'll have a lot to talk about when we get back, Jin's brother."

While leaving the center of the battlefield, Jin and his companions focused their gaze on the aerial fortress Vessel. Every time Masalrun's curse receded, Vessel fired its cannons into Lafrarosa's rift.
'Brothers, don't get hurt and wait just a little longer.'
Jin pictured his brothers beyond that rift as he left the battlefield.
Zipl, Tower of the Story.
As Kelliac entered, Ronil, Satrin, and Lagal rose from their seats. Kadun and Elona remained seated and greeted him with their eyes.
"Have you arrived, Head?"
Kelliac had just returned from meeting Joshua Ganesto. He had needed to seek Ganesto's opinion on the demons in the desert.
"As expected, all the demons summoned in the desert are underlings of the witch. No, to be precise... they are figures who have been granted residency in the abyss by the witch."
"Residency in the abyss? What is that, Kelliac?"
"It simply means beings that can live in the witch's realm without suffering any harm."
"Anyway... so the fact that they are not the witch's underlings means they are not controlled by Ganesto?"
Kelliac met Kadun's eyes and nodded.
"Originally, the witch neither keeps subordinates nor her own forces. There are only those who follow her blindly."
Examples of this were the fragments of chaos known as the witch's daughter, and characters like Masalroon.
Helluram never issued direct orders to her followers. Consequently, the followers often interpreted her intentions on their own.
"Well, whether the witch or Ganesto controls them or not, it won't be bad for us now. Isn't that right, Kellic friend?"
"It would have been so originally."
"...Originally?"
A wrinkle appeared on Kellic's brow.
Until meeting Joshua and confirming new information, the trio of demons had certainly been a boon to Zipel. Since the demons were holding back the enemy's forces, Zipel would have had more leeway.

"Laprarosa. According to Joshua, due to the summoning of the demons and the battle, a passage connecting the desert land of Myungwang to the insurgents has been created. He said that two who are called 'The Two Kings of Myungwang' have already been released."
-We'll have to talk with Ganesto about those demons. Anyway, from now on, we need to focus on the holy land and the divine stone. Unless another variable appears in the desert.
Kellic recalled his words, uttered right after luring the enemy into the desert, and touched his forehead.
From that point, the variable had already occurred.

"The Two Kings of Myungwang!? Kellic friend, are they the enemy or the descendants of the clear blue clan!? No, only the descendants of the clear blue are left now, right? Are the clear blue bastards more dangerous than the remaining great enemy kings?"
"If you think of the Myungwang's Two Kings temporarily summoned by Jin Runekandel, they might be stronger. But even that, compared to their divine warriors... would not be a problem."
The divine half.
His transcendental passivity during the time of the Abomination Shrine was neither a forgotten legend nor an inflated myth.
"The moment he is fully summoned, the situation in the insurgents will be completely incalculable."
Zipel, Kinzello, the enemy clans, Ganesto, the Sun Church.
There was doubt whether all of them combined could face the combined forces of Ban and Myungwang.
"Then we must also participate in the battle for the Mithra Desert."
Elona spoke in an emotionless voice.
"Before that divine being called a divine warrior and the Myungwang come over, it's best to completely destroy the passage. Am I wrong, Kellic?"
"You're right. Blocking the Myungwang has become more urgent than moving the holy land and restoring our forces. From the next battle, we must also enter the desert."
"Kellic friend, then shall we propose negotiations to the enemy clan? Anyway, both we and they must stop the Myungwang..."
"Hey, Ragal. These are the ones who stole Drakka from us a while ago. Have you no pride?"
At Kadun's sharp response, Ragal shrugged his shoulders as if embarrassed.

"I just suggested a rational opinion. But thinking about it again, pride is pride, and since we have a friend like Elona, it might be better to go in the direction of wiping out the enemies altogether."
Of course, the best result for Zipl was for the enemies to suffer as much damage as possible before the passage of Lapralosa was destroyed.

"There's no need to negotiate separately with the Redmy Tribe. As soon as they know we're trying to destroy the Lapralosa passage, they'll respond passively to us. The summoned demons are favoring the Barmel Alliance, so from the Redmy Tribe's point of view, we're playing that role."
"Then it's better not to use the airborne fortress that our friend Elona stole from the Redmy Tribe. If we unnecessarily provoke their pride, the situation may get tangled."

"...Ragal, you're really annoying. How many more times do I have to explain that I'm not your friend? It's better to stop ignoring what I say. If it weren't for Kellyak, you would have been dead by my hand at least ten times."
Elona glared at Ragal and spoke. She still felt a surge of anger whenever she looked at Ragal.
'...She still harbors hostility towards Ragal. Is the Sacred Vessel still not fully controlling Elona?'
Kellyak thought.

He knew exactly why Elona was unusually fierce toward Ragal. It was because, before Elona used the Sacred Vessel, she bore a grudge against Ragal. During her time with Veradin, Elona suffered serious injuries while protecting the citizens of the federation from Ragal.
'I have to keep in mind that Elona Zipl might suddenly escape the control of the Sacred Vessel. Before that happens, we have to move the sanctuary and strengthen the Sacred Vessel.'
There was no reason for Elona, who had escaped the control of the Sacred Vessel, to stay in the current Zipl. If that happened, she would surely join the Barmel Alliance where Veradin was.

'And when the control of the Sacred Vessel is perfected, then we can finally melt Elona Zipl completely into the Stone of the Demon God... Once all of this is successfully completed, from then on, Zipl will be able to rewrite the history of the world. From the beginning to the end.'
While Kellyak was thinking this way, Elona quietly suppressed the discomfort that had started with Ragal.

'Sometimes, not only Ragal but also when dealing with Kellyak Zipl, hostility surges. There must be some reason... When the opportunity comes, I'll have to ask the tower when Kellyak is not around. Where this hostility comes from. What to do if the day comes when I can no longer suppress the hostility.'
Elona was vaguely aware. Both Ragal and Kellyak may have had some grudge against her in the past.
Elona was lost in thought for a while, recalling a voice she had heard in hell.
- Lady Elona! Don't forget, I will find you again! Don't forget! Don't forget...!
It was the voice of Veradin Zipl.
